Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogical relationship, conflating Frederick’s father with his paternal grandfather. Even after WebSurfer correctly identified Siegfried’s father as Wigeric of Lotharingia, the Planner concluded that the paternal grandfather was Siegfried (the father) instead of Wigeric (the father of Siegfried), resulting in the incorrect final answer.
